Company names, subjects and the filing PDF are NSE's own, reproduced unchanged; the document stays on their server and every row links to it where NSE gave a link. The ticker on each row is this dashboard's resolution of the filing company's name to an NSE symbol, so the feed can be narrowed to a reader's holdings; a name we cannot place keeps ticker null and shows only in Universe. Nothing here is scored, ranked or judged.

rows.subject: Updates
rows.description: Era Infra Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding the appointment of the Compliance Officer of the Company.'  In this regard, we wish to clarify that Ms. Arunima Trigunayat was appointed as the Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company with effect from May 12, 2025, pursuant to the approval of the Board under Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013.Upon relisting of the Company's securities on the recognised stock exchanges in December 2025, Ms. Arunima Trigunayat, being the existing Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, was entrusted with the responsibilities of the Compliance Officer in terms of Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, no separate announcement was made in respect of her appointment dated May 12, 2025, as the Company was not listed on the said date.However, pursuant to the advice of the Stock Exchange, the Company is now making the requisite announcement in this regard for your information and records.We request you to kindly take the above clarification on record. |SUBJECT: Updates
